Title: Beyonder Clan
ChangeLog:
Version 0.9.8:

 [Bux Fix] The vanish effect of Loco Motive Horror variant C will no longer trigger in preview mode. This will prevent it from erroneously returning from the dead.

 [Bug fix] Apostle of the Void will now properly kill Undretch and Veilrich units at +2/-2 Mania. Previously, it would preview the death effects at +2/-2 Mania, but wait until +3/-3 Mania to actually kill them.

 [Bug fix] Disabling the Beyonder clan mod on the main menu screen will now clear the current selections for Mutators and Expert Challenges. This prevents some visual glitches that can occur from referencing content that does not exist in the base game on the clan selsection screen.

 * Loco Motive Conductor variant C's Hysteria effect now also roots enemies in addition to mutating them, but the effect only targets non-mutated enemies. The jitters effect for enemy mutated units on anxiety remains unchanged.

 * Beyonder-specific common magic upgrades (-1 compulsive, +10 spell power afflictive) will now always re-roll into a different option. This also slightly reduces the frequency they can appear.
